changeSet.author: FStavcev
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY ,username VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL ,email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL ,created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL ,updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL ,CONSTRAINT uk_users_username UNIQUE (username) ,CONSTRAINT uk_users_email UNIQUE (email) );

rollback.sql: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS users CASCADE;
